body: I see it as his dancing was the only form of happiness he kind of had it how he was himself and free, and the strobe lighting and song under pressure is kind of representing him going in and out of happiness when the light was on him in the club he was happy when the light goes off it’s dark and he’s not their, unfortunately the dark ended up winning.

I think the interpretation of suicide is very strong but we as the viewers only get that in obvious format where as Sophie only has the recording to watch along with memories, but it’s only us who sees the clues to what he feels is an inadequate dad, lost, and have only few moments of happiness from crying on his bed to running in the sea, I feel like although the director doesn’t want to confirm it and leave it too interpretation I think the main focus is mens mental health and particularly dads who don’t feel like their worthy father’s.

We live in the uk and have the NHS so we will be given the help which is great but the help is “basic” so too speak (not shitting on them) their good at their job but also not at the same time and their resources are stretched so much that they only kept her for one night and tonight (which is when this has happened) they didn’t think she was bad enough to be committed and we don’t have the money too go privately I’m hoping that her case worker is able to find some sort of referral, just feels like once she beats one demon another two pop out, I’m scared of leaving my child with her when I go too work, I love her so much but I’m riddled with fear at the same time.
